description: Source code implementing x86 instruction decoding, specifically handling ModR/M and SIB bytes, register decoding, and address expression parsing for 32-bit and 16-bit modes.

classes.name: modRM_byte
classes.description: Bitfield structure representing the ModR/M byte with 'mod', 'reg', and 'rm' fields.

classes.name: SIB_byte
classes.description: Bitfield structure representing the SIB byte with 'scale', 'index', and 'base' fields.

methods.name: imm32_signsized
methods.description: Converts a buffer to a signed integer of specified size, with sign extension.

methods.name: byte_decode
methods.description: Decodes a byte into its bitfield components for ModR/M or SIB.

methods.name: sib_decode
methods.description: Decodes the SIB byte and sets address expression components accordingly.

methods.name: ia32_modrm_decode
methods.description: Decodes the ModR/M byte and associated addressing modes for 32-bit and 16-bit instructions.

methods.name: ia32_reg_decode
methods.description: Decodes a register operand from a byte.
